create_code_formula_model: create a CodeFormulaModel instance to enrich documents with code and formula predictions
download_code_formula_model: download the CodeFormula model artifacts from HuggingFace Hub to a local directory
test_is_processable: test whether a document element can be processed by the CodeFormulaModel for code or formula enrichment
run_code_formula_enrichment: run the CodeFormulaModel on a batch of document elements to predict code languages and enrich text
extract_code_language: extract a programming language tag from a string formatted as <_language_> and return the remainder
